Established in 1947, George Plumbing has proudly served the greater San Antonio area for 75 years and counting.

George Plumbing was established in 1947 by George F. Saliba. Mr. Saliba began his career as a master plumber in 1920 in San Antonio, Texas. We are proud of our George Plumbing history in San Antonio.

Mission: Founded in 1947, our mission is to develop lifelong relationships by providing quality communication and craftsmanship.

Family

Family: More than a workplace, we are a community. We support, uplift, and respect one another, creating an environment where everyone belongs and thrives.
